'''Dan Glitch''' is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the image on four cards.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref><ref name="pcimages">Players Committee card images at res.starwarsccg.org (Virtual Sets 0–27, Virtual Premium and alternate images at 745 × 1039; Virtual Blocks 1–9 and Virtual Shields at 350 × 490), the source the card label data was read from. Each card's article shows its image.</ref> The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Block 9]] (2014), [[Virtual Set 0]] (2014) and [[Virtual Set 8]] (2017), so the credited cards span 2014–2017. Dan Glitch is listed on [[Card Credits#Dan Glitch|Card Credits]].
